name: Study of the Elements: Rock
summary: In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus needs stone shards to test his work on elemental shackles. Lesser rock elementals roam the hills just west of him.

sections.title: Elemental Shackles
sections.body: In the Badlands, Lotwil Veriatus is making shackles of elemental binding. When finished, they will let mages summon stronger elementals for greater uses. To test his offensive spells and a few pieced-together gizmos, he needs ten small stone shards. Lesser rock elementals roam the hills immediately west.

faq.q: Who is asking for the stone shards?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus is asking for stone shards as he works in the Badlands.

faq.q: What is Lotwil Veriatus working on?
faq.answer: Lotwil Veriatus is making shackles of elemental binding. They will let mages summon stronger elementals.

faq.q: Why does Lotwil need small stone shards?
faq.answer: Lotwil needs the shards to test offensive spells and a few pieced-together gizmos.

faq.q: Where are the stone shards found?
faq.answer: The shards come from lesser rock elementals in the hills immediately west of Lotwil.

angles.text: As a mage, you are among those Lotwil's shackles are meant to serve.
